title: Why This Mother Left California to Start a New Life in Croatia
description: Anamaria shares how she moved from San Diego to Promina with her daughter, shipped her family’s household to Croatia, gained Croatian citizenship and began building Pure Promina.

title: Croatian Citizenship by Descent: How I Got Approved 🇭🇷
description: Meet Carl Tomich in our introduction video as he shares his personal journey to Croatian citizenship by descent, from researching family records to receiving approval.

title: From Melbourne to Croatia, Family, Citizenship and Starting Again
description: Julia shares her journey from a childhood in Melbourne to life in Samobor, discussing family, Croatian citizenship, changing work plans and rebuilding her life. Includes discussion of domestic abuse and bereavement.
